title: Light-Truck Tow Rate — Road Hazard Protection
content:
Tows of vehicles on light-truck tires carry a higher tow rate under Road Hazard Protection. A light-truck line is a Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty tire line whose original tread depth is at least 13/32 inch; the line is that of the covered set.

**Tow light-truck rate.** On a Commercial LT plan (the plan that covers commercial use) for a covered set of a line whose original tread depth is at least 13/32 inch, the tow rate is 1.25; on any other plan for a set of such a light-truck line, the tow rate is 1.1; on a set of any other line the tow rate is 1.

| Plan | Covered set's line: original tread 13/32 or more | Covered set's line: original tread below 13/32 |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Road Hazard Commercial LT Protection | 1.25 | 1 |
| Crestline Road Hazard Plus 36-Month or Life-of-Tread Protection | 1.1 | 1 |

**Boundary (hypothetical lines).** A line with 13/32 new tread is a light-truck line and takes 1.25 or 1.1 by plan; a line with 12/32 is not and takes 1.
